entries.reason: the protocol's three required methods take PHContentEditingInput, PHContentEditingOutput and PHAdjustmentData, and this port carries none of them: all three are absent rows of registry/Photos/absent_Photos.json, in the Photos family and not in this one, so there is nothing here to declare a protocol over, and iOS 6's library has no editing extension that would be the one calling it
entries.effect: the protocol is not there: NSProtocolFromString answers nil
entries.source: PHContentEditingController.h of the iOS 16.4 SDK and of the iOS 26.2 SDK, whose three required methods name PHAdjustmentData, PHContentEditingInput and PHContentEditingOutput; registry/Photos/absent_Photos.json, where those three classes are absent and each says why; sdk-26.2-surface.tsv for the row and its introduced release

entries.reason: what the view shows is a PHLivePhoto - the livePhoto property holds one, the two playback methods play one, and the badge says a live photo is there - and this port carries no PHLivePhoto: it is an absent row of registry/Photos/absent_Photos.json, in the Photos family and not in this one. A view declared over a class that is not there would be a name and nothing else
entries.effect: the class is not there: NSClassFromString answers nil and alloc on a compile time reference crashes
entries.source: PHLivePhotoView.h of the iOS 16.4 SDK and of the iOS 26.2 SDK, whose livePhoto property is typed PHLivePhoto *; registry/Photos/absent_Photos.json, where PHLivePhoto is absent and says why; tools/cache-index/first-rung.py, which reads PHLivePhoto first at 9.1 and no held release of this port below it

entries.reason: every method of the protocol takes a PHLivePhotoView, and that class is not carried for the reason its own row gives, so a class could conform to a protocol whose subject does not exist and would never be handed one to be asked about
entries.effect: the protocol is not there: NSProtocolFromString answers nil
entries.source: PHLivePhotoView.h of the iOS 16.4 SDK and of the iOS 26.2 SDK, whose four delegate methods all take a PHLivePhotoView; registry/PhotosUI/absent_PhotosUI.json for the row of that class; tools/cache-index/first-rung.py, which reads PHLivePhotoViewDelegate first at 9.2 and no held release of this port below it
